full_prompt_en: A square classical oil portrait places a young man in a white hooded robe against a nearly black interior background. The unadorned dark field surrounds his head and shoulders, turning the broad pale garment into the principal shape. He stands frontally near the center and looks outward with a quiet, serious expression. Short dark hair, a softly lit forehead and a slightly shadowed cheek are described with smooth transitions rather than visible outline. The hood falls around his neck in thick layered folds, and a wide shoulder cape sweeps from left to right over the looser sleeves. A thin cord gathers the robe at the waist near the bottom edge. In his left hand, at the lower left of center, he supports a large round brown object with a rough seam or crease on its top. The fingertips curl beneath its weight. His right hand grips a thick upright volume at the opposite side. The block has a dark brown cover and densely stacked page edges, creating a firm vertical counterweight to the round object. The white cloth is not uniformly bright: cream highlights lie on the shoulder and chest, while warm gray shadows collect inside the hood, beneath the cape and in the sleeves. The background shifts subtly from deep black on the left to dark umber on the right, giving the figure a small amount of space without a visible room. A focused warm light arrives from the upper left and front, illuminating the face, upper robe and tops of the held forms; hands and lower folds sink into deeper tone. The painting gives skin a quiet, blended finish and cloth a denser, matte surface with broad sculptural folds. No other figures or decorative details distract from the restrained arrangement. The overall composition balances one pale upright form with a dark enclosure, using the round and rectangular objects to stabilize the lower half.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古典油画肖像把一位身穿白色带兜帽长袍的年轻男子置于近乎黑色的室内背景前。没有装饰的深色区域环绕头肩，使宽大的浅色衣袍成为主要形体。他靠近中央正面站立，以安静而严肃的神情望向画外。短深发、柔和受光的额头和略有阴影的面颊由平滑过渡描绘，而非明显勾线。兜帽在颈边堆成厚叠褶皱，宽肩披从左到右掠过更宽松的袖子。一根细绳在靠近底边的腰间束起衣袍。他的左手在中央偏左下方托着一个较大的棕色圆物，顶端有粗糙接缝或折痕。指尖弯在其下承受重量。右手在另一侧握住一册厚重竖立的书。深褐色封面和紧密叠起的书页边构成坚实竖向重量，与圆物相对。白布并非均匀明亮：奶油色高光落在肩与胸前，暖灰阴影聚在兜帽内部、肩披下和袖子里。背景由左侧深黑微微转向右侧深赭，给人物留出少量空间，却没有可见房间。聚焦暖光从左上和正前方到来，照亮面孔、衣袍上部与所持形体顶面；双手和下方褶皱退入更深色调。绘画让皮肤平静而融合，衣料则更厚重哑光，褶皱宽大如雕塑。没有其他人物或装饰细节分散注意力。整体构图以浅色直立形体平衡深暗围合，并借圆形与矩形物件稳住下半幅。
style_prompt_en: The image has a classical oil-painted finish shaped by broad pale masses against an almost black ground. Warm cream and gray passages describe rounded folds, while deep umber surrounds them and absorbs less important edges. The focal planes are softly blended, but selected seams and hard edges receive firm definition. A single warm light from an upper frontal side builds volume through gentle highlights and substantial nested shadows. Matte surfaces carry restrained texture, with shape and tonal transition doing more work than decoration. The space is very shallow, and a clear vertical center is balanced by contrasting compact round and rectangular forms below. The overall effect is still and contemplative, with a disciplined light-dark hierarchy giving a small group of forms quiet gravity.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有古典油画完成面，宽大的浅色形体在近黑底色前被塑造。暖奶油色和灰色区域描绘圆润褶面，深赭色在周围吸收次要边缘。焦点平面柔和融合，所选接缝与硬边则得到坚实定义。单一的暖光从上方偏正面进入，以柔和高光和充足的嵌套阴影建立体积。哑光表面肌理克制，形状和色调过渡比装饰承担更多作用。空间极浅，清楚的竖向中心由下方对照的紧凑圆形与矩形形体平衡。整体效果静止而沉思，严格的明暗层级赋予少量形体安静的重量。
theme_en: A young robed man holding a round brown object and a thick book against darkness
theme_zh: 一位身穿白袍的年轻男子在暗背景前手持棕色圆物与厚书
name: Francisco de Zurbaran
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
